name: wal_sender_timeout
description: Maximum time a WAL sender waits for replication activity before terminating the connection.
symptoms: Undetected primary crashes in distributed clusters
tuning_tips: Set to 5–30 seconds (5000–30000 ms) for low-latency clusters; increase to 60–120 seconds in high-latency or unstable networks; set to 0 only for debugging or fully trusted networks.
